edges.effect_quant: Different designs and subgroups point in different directions, so a single pooled estimate is not the right way to read this edge.
edges.mechanism: Any amputation signal is thought to relate less to direct tissue toxicity than to volume depletion, impaired wound healing in high-risk diabetic feet, and residual confounding by baseline vascular disease.
edges.summary: What makes this pair believable is not one flashy paper but the way the literature stacks up: the 2019 Donnan meta analysis in BMJ Open already points to sglt2 inhibitors produces mixed findings across studies, and later studies mostly refine the size of the effect rather than overturning it. In practice this reads more like a real risk signal than a one-off finding.
edges.caveats: This is a contested edge. Exposure measurement, confounding, and publication-era effects all matter, so confidence should stay low until cleaner data accumulate.
